source: User request in this Codex chat, 2026-10-08
model: none: deterministic app/runtime/UI contract evaluation; no live Pi model calls

run_rule.gate: All required applicable checks pass in the same attempt, then base, holdout and related regressions pass on the final source. Missing prerequisites block before scoring; measurement errors never pass.

action_limits: No real connected-account, live model or real recipient calls from automated tests.
Live provider contract probes use only task-created synthetic sessions/files and clean them up.
No project-wide OAuth verifier activation, existing account mutation or key revocation during compatibility research.

cases.prompt: I just installed Otto. Let me connect Gmail without configuring Composio.
cases.setup: Fresh disposable local profile; no Composio environment variables; real app and deployed Worker.
cases.expected_result: Keyless catalog, consent and usable owner account.
cases.holdout: Fresh disposable server profile with HTTPS callback.
cases.answer_key: Evaluator-owned assertions and synthetic input manifest frozen before attempt; never inserted into app agent context.

cases.prompt: I upgraded Otto. Keep using the apps I already connected.

cases.expected_result: Same active connection and account survive; execution and inbox polling still use their original account.
cases.holdout: Two accounts for the same toolkit plus another toolkit, restarted twice.
cases.answer_key: Evaluator-owned assertions and synthetic input manifest frozen before attempt; never inserted into app agent context.
